summary: Onslow County tower on the NC lookout tower list, at coordinates 34.71222, -77.25416; no history, design or fate found in any source reached.

evidence.supports: tower named Hubert in Onslow County, at coordinates 34.71222, -77.25416

notes_for_editor: Very thin. The tnlandforms NC tower list is the only source that names this tower. Its code column reads '0 bm' with no survey code. The Eastern US Lookouts NC page lists other Onslow County towers (Comfort, Deppe, Dixon and five towers around Camp Lejeune) but has no Hubert entry, so the record may be wrong or the tower may be known under another name. The NHLR NC index and the NHLR and FFLOS caches have no Hubert entry. Two web searches returned only Hubert-area wildfire and fire-station news and background on the Hofmann Forest; the Deppe tower is a different lookout. The story is about 50 words, far below the usual 120, and was kept short rather than padded. Check NC Division of Forest Resources tower records and Onslow County history before publishing.
